representation: A block on an adjustable incline with the vertical weight vector resolved into a down-slope component and a perpendicular component, plus the outward normal force.
motion: The incline, block and all three arrows recompute directly from the angle slider; the vertex marker pulses during replay.
checkpoints: along-plane component grows with sin theta
normal force follows cos theta and is less than weight when tilted
misconceptionTest: At a steep angle the normal arrow becomes visibly shorter than the weight arrow; text states that N equals mg only at zero degrees. No friction arrow is drawn, and a checkpoint says friction is a separate force, not equal to weight.
accessibility: Alt text; keyboard angle slider; each arrow has a text label and a distinct direction, so meaning is not carried by color.
